scope: Transport callback seam; full Turso host invitation/membership tests are separate
observations: Persisted-seed interface gives domain signatures and Iroh the same device identity
Separate real browser endpoints exchange authenticated messages in both directions
Callback receives transport identity despite a forged payload ID; handler rejection and malformed requests fail the exchange
Wrong contact identity and payloads above 8 MiB are rejected at the transport boundary
Reopening the endpoint with the same supplied seed preserves identity and allows reconnection
Incoming work is limited to 16 handlers; closing the endpoint retires all pending exchanges
